Synopsis:
    Russian filmmaker Pavel Talankin, who covertly documented pro-war indoctrination in a Chelyabinsk-region school for the Oscar-winning documentary "Mr. Nobody Against Putin," is being condemned on Russian state TV by his former teacher. Talankin, now a foreign agent-designee living in exile since 2024, says the film exposes generational militarization of Russian youth. The state TV segment frames his work as betrayal of the motherland, using his elderly former teacher as a sympathetic voice of condemnation.
